basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer based in Vancouver, Canada. I've recently taken an interest in personal finance, specifically investing through TFSAs and ETFs. In my spare time, I enjoy listening to podcasts like the Duncan Trussell Family Hour and discussing alternative finance strategies. I'm currently in a relationship and we are planning to convert a school bus into a mobile home. Typically online during the evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a computer science degree and work in tech, which keeps me engaged with problem-solving and analytics. My interest in finance is recent, driven by a desire to better manage my personal savings and investments. I'm self-taught in finance, learning through online resources, Reddit discussions, and trial and error.
